basic_info.description: Please submit your offer before 12/16/24- Discover your dream home at 101 Lombard in the heart of San Francisco's North Waterfront. This stunning residence offers a seamless open floor plan, connecting a spacious living and dining area to a large deck with views of Coit Tower,landscaped gardens and Telegraph Hill. Enjoy cozy evenings by the wood-burning fireplace. Room for versatile office space, ideal for working from home. The residence features beautiful hardwood floors and an efficient galley kitchen that opens to the living area, good storage and an integrated washer/dryer area. The master suite is a peaceful retreat, overlooking lush gardens and Coit Tower, complete with a walk-in closet plus vanity area with custom built-ins. The remodeled split bathroom includes separate sink/vanity area.  Step outside to explore the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, and Farmer's Market.
